description: This file implements the IR reader for protobuf-encoded data, parsing protobuf translation units and converting them into internal IR representations, including functions, types, and global variables.

classes.name: ProtobufIRReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading protobuf-encoded IR data and converting it into internal representations.

methods.name: ReadTypeInfo
methods.description: Populates a TypeIR object with data from a BasicNamedAndTypedDecl protobuf message.

methods.name: ReadDumpImpl
methods.description: Reads and parses a protobuf text format file into internal IR structures.

methods.name: TemplateInfoProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf TemplateInfo to internal IR representation.

methods.name: SetupCFunctionLikeIR
methods.description: Sets up function-like IR objects from protobuf data.

methods.name: FunctionProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf FunctionDecl to internal FunctionIR.

methods.name: FunctionTypeProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf FunctionType to internal FunctionTypeIR.

methods.name: VTableLayoutProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf VTableLayout to internal VTableLayoutIR.

methods.name: RecordFieldsProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf RecordFieldDecl list to internal vector of RecordFieldIR.

methods.name: RecordCXXBaseSpecifiersProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf CXXBaseSpecifier list to internal vector of CXXBaseSpecifierIR.

methods.name: RecordTypeProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf RecordType to internal RecordTypeIR.

methods.name: EnumFieldsProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf EnumFieldDecl list to internal vector of EnumFieldIR.

methods.name: EnumTypeProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts protobuf EnumType to internal EnumTypeIR.

methods.name: ReadGlobalVariables
methods.description: Reads global variables from protobuf TranslationUnit into internal IR.

methods.name: ReadPointerTypes
methods.description: Reads pointer types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadBuiltinTypes
methods.description: Reads builtin types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadQualifiedTypes
methods.description: Reads qualified types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.description: Reads array types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadLvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Reads lvalue reference types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadRvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Reads rvalue reference types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadFunctions
methods.description: Reads functions from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadRecordTypes
methods.description: Reads record types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadFunctionTypes
methods.description: Reads function types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.name: ReadEnumTypes
methods.description: Reads enum types from protobuf TranslationUnit.

methods.description: Reads ELF functions from protobuf TranslationUnit.
